environment.hardware_qualification: Unqualified execution host; CPU/SSD target hardware not verified.

definitions.p95: Nearest-rank percentile of wall-clock sample durations.
definitions.model_edit: Canonical candidate transaction against original loaded fixture; includes validation/history; excludes GUI input and paint.
definitions.full_reflow: After a canonical paragraph insertion, construct shared QTextDocument and resolve all physical display pages; includes full layout, excludes paint and the edit itself.
definitions.inspection: Bounded semantic inspection against an already loaded document.
definitions.fixture_load: Fixture construction excluded from every timed operation.
definitions.gui_startup_to_window: Fresh interpreter process launch until MainWindow with the fixture is shown, exposed and its first paint processed; includes Python/Qt import and package load.
definitions.keystroke_to_paint: QTest key press delivered through the event loop to the editor plus a synchronous viewport repaint; excludes the 300 ms idle commit.
definitions.typing_commit: flush_edits after one keystroke: canonical transaction, history delta and sidebar/status refresh.
definitions.structural_edit_to_paint: Paragraph style change from the GUI command through commit, editor document update and synchronous viewport repaint.
definitions.structural_full_rebuild_to_paint: Same edit forced through a full shared-document rebuild, for comparison.
definitions.save_ui_block: Time save() holds the UI thread before returning to the event loop; serialization continues on a worker.
definitions.save_completion: Time until the worker save finishes and the window marks the document saved.
definitions.idle_cpu_percent: Process CPU time divided by wall time while the loaded window runs its event loop without input.

target_comparison.typing_50ms: not_measured: model transaction excludes GUI feedback
target_comparison.reflow_500ms: full reflow proxy only; affected-region GUI feedback unmeasured
